query:
-- 模擬當前計算邏輯：按 createdAt 過濾 90 天，按 soldAt 或 createdAt 排序
SELECT 
  ph.price,
  ph.soldAt,
  ph.createdAt,
  COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt) as sortDate,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), ph.createdAt) as createdDaysAgo,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt)) as sortDaysAgo
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Japanese National Team%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
  AND ph.createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
ORDER BY COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt) ASC
LIMIT 5;
